acceptance_gates.title: Pad shows Pikachu on the device
verify: Served HTML nav and #view-cards title say Pad. data-view cards, decks, fight, and lab remain. #padDevice starts at data-mode=pokemon and contains a play control named 朗读.
styles.css has a landscape rule for .pad-device, a red upper shell, a white lower shell, and a screen idle state. Page chrome does not include TRAINER or 081/088.

GET /api/pad/species?q=皮卡丘 returns one entry: id 25, name 皮卡丘, type 电, category 鼠宝可梦, ability 静电, height_m 0.4, weight_kg 6.0, a non-empty zh-Hans flavor line, artwork URL, animation URL, cry URL, and speech_text containing 皮卡丘, 鼠宝可梦, and that flavor line.
q=pikachu and q=25 return the same id. An unknown query returns HTTP 404 and no invented flavor.
Species 152 returns name 菊草叶, an empty flavor, and speech_text that contains 菊草叶 and no Latin Pokédex sentence.
app.js starts speechSynthesis from #padSpeak with lang zh-CN and cancels speech on a second press. The cry URL is assigned to an audio element.
#findPanel, #addName, #findScan, and #ownedGrid remain inside #view-cards. parkCardsPanel still moves the finder. Card mode is #padDevice[data-mode=card] showing #cardsHost.

acceptance_gates.title: A photo resolves to a species
verify: Posting an image whose dHash matches cached official artwork of species 25 returns match one and id 25.
Two close hashes and no clear winner return match many including the right id. A distant hash returns match none and no entry name.
POST /api/pad/photo does not create a deck and does not call the card recognizer. #findScan still submits card photos through the existing recognize path.

acceptance_gates.title: Pad epic exit
verify: Pad slices do not modify app/engine/game.py or app/engine/effects.py.
The Pad page still has one device, Pokémon search, 朗读, card mode, and photo match, as locked by those tests.
